answer_text: Yes. UMG Article 4.3 (Réseaux divers) requires all networks to be installed underground: (c-01)[Tous les réseaux sont implantés en souterrain.] This rule sits under UMG Article 4, which governs network service conditions for terrains: (c-02)[ARTICLE 4 - zone UMG - CONDITIONS DE DESSERTE DES TERRAINS PAR LES RESEAUX D'EAU, D'ELECTRICITE, D'ASSAINISSEMENT ET DE REALISATION D'UN ASSAINISSEMENT INDIVIDUEL].
additional_context: Page reference: the planner cited Article 4.3 at printed p. 323 (pdf 324). The heading is on printed p. 322 (pdf 323): (c-03)[4.3. - RESEAUX DIVERS heading appears on printed page 322]. Printed p. 323 (pdf 324) contains Articles 6.1 to 6.3. The rule text contains no exception clause. Whether it governs the specific RSE and Jeunes Actifs network design was not assessed here.
